_comment: roi/exclude_roi are [[x,y],...] polygons in 1920x1080 space. Detection ignores 'vehicle' (the BBQ trips it). null rtsp_camera_direct / email.to are filled in from local.env (see h32env.py). Email: set enabled=true and fill detector/secrets.json (copy secrets.json.example).
_comment_scenery: Static garden furniture reads as a low-confidence person to MegaDetector — that is what produced 56 bogus PERSON events on 2026-08-16, and then the rock that kept firing that afternoon. See scenery.py. min_move is how far a box must travel (as a fraction of its own size) before it counts as alive, and applies to a spot we have only just noticed: raise it if furniture still gets through, lower it if slow animals are missed. A spot we have watched for jitter_learn_secs is instead judged against the wobble it actually shows, times jitter_slack — the rock's box breathes by 6% of its own size while the rock does not move at all, which is MORE than the raccoon really moved, so a fixed min_move cannot separate them. Lower jitter_slack if wobbly furniture still gets through; raise it if something that genuinely moves a little is missed. iou_match is how nearly two boxes must coincide to count as the same spot: it has to be loose enough to tolerate that wobble, or one boulder sprawls into dozens of anchors and each one starts out trusting again. static_after_secs is how long a never-moving spot must keep flickering before it is written off as scenery; conf_certain is the confidence at which a detection is believed regardless. Learned spots live in detector/scenery.json — delete that file to forget them.
_comment_signal: signal_timeout_secs: no frame for this long and the monitor says NO CAMERA SIGNAL, detection pauses and no events fire (rather than sitting on the last frame with a ticking clock).
_comment_talk: Two-way talk (see talk.py). On a confirmed detection of greet_on ('person'), the camera speaker says greet_text in greet_voice (a macOS `say` voice; Anna is German female). greet_once=true = just the first time per run (a proof); set false + greet_cooldown_secs to greet every visit. Needs H32_CAMERA_DEVID in local.env (capture it with capture/capture_talk.py) — without it, talk is off. Fires only on the post-scenery-filter person, so the bench/rock never trigger it.
_comment_faces: Face identification (see faces.py). Needs detector/get-face-models.sh and somebody enrolled via detector/enroll.py. Faces are only looked for INSIDE a person box - searching the whole frame finds the plastic bucket. Identity is decided by voting across a visit because a face is only visible in ~38% of frames. threshold 0.40 sits above SFace's own 0.363 and margin 0.10 forces an ambiguous face to 'unknown', because the false-accept rate on this camera is UNMEASURED - see TODO.md. known_suppresses_event stays false until it is measured: turning it on lets a stranger who matches you cancel your own alert.
